model.name: Diagram background-drag pans the viewport with a MOUSE (parity with touch) — unify on POINTER events, one handler
model.description: On a diagram, panning the viewport by dragging the BACKGROUND works with TOUCH (finger) but NOT with a MOUSE. Mouse parity required — the same background-drag pans the viewport with a mouse. Likely cause: pan handlers bound to touch events only (touchstart/touchmove).
model.tronQuote: in the diagramms i can pan the position via finger but not via mouse when i am on the diagram background. it needs to work with the mouse too

discoverySource.note: Diagram background pan works touch, not mouse. Mouse parity. Same family as R22.2 (drawer pan/zoom) + parked 1cbad4ef (iframe pinch).

model.crossRefNote: Same pan/zoom-input-parity family as R22.2 (drawer pan/zoom, touch-first mouse-parity, device-only touch half) + parked 1cbad4ef (iframe pinch-scale, open mobile gap). This is the DIAGRAM viewport background-pan mouse-parity.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Dragging the diagram BACKGROUND with a MOUSE pans the viewport.
The existing TOUCH pan continues to work UNCHANGED — this is PARITY, not replacement (no reverse regression).
Background-drag does NOT hijack node drag / selection / text-selection — panning only on the background, not on a node.
★ The gate asserts the RESULT — the viewport POSITION actually CHANGED after a mouse drag — NOT that a listener/handler exists. A bound listener that moves nothing is the empty-container class.
Desktop-MOUSE half = AUTOMATABLE-gated (viewport moved on mouse drag); the TOUCH half stays DEVICE-VERIFIED (real device).

★ BY-CONSTRUCTION: unify on POINTER events (pointerdown/pointermove/pointerup) — ONE handler covering mouse + touch + pen. Do NOT add a parallel mouse handler beside the touch one: two input paths for one behaviour is the two-sources disease and they WILL drift (one gets a fix the other does not — which is exactly how the finger/mouse gap arose). Also check whether this belongs to the EXISTING RbPanZoom component rather than a per-view handler (single-source the pan behaviour).
